ideas.pitch: A real-time safety and incident monitoring dashboard tailored for late-night city navigation in Kolkata during large events and festivals.
ideas.title: NightWatch Kolkata: Real-Time Urban Safety Heatmap
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages local context of Kolkata and incorporates real-time geospatial data pipelines which appeal heavily to judges looking for practical urban impact.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered log auditing agent that automatically detects application anomalies, creates evidence-backed summaries, and opens verified pull requests for fixes.
ideas.title: PhantomLog: Autonomous Nighttime Error and Incident Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven grand prize winning pattern of building autonomous data incident response agents with rigorous evidence gating.

ideas.pitch: A deterministic local sensor telemetry monitor that operates under intermittent network conditions with strict human-in-the-loop controls.
ideas.title: ShadowStrike: Edge-Based Threat Detection and Response
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on hard engineering constraints like low-latency local execution and deterministic safety engagement gates.

ideas.pitch: A submission-to-prototype generator that takes structural concept PPTs and rapidly spins up boilerplate frontends for fast hackathon validation.
ideas.title: SpectreForm: Instant PPT to Working UI Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the event workflow where teams must pitch via PPT and quickly spin up working proof-of-concepts for the offline round.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision utility leveraging pose estimation to analyze sports mechanics with high-confidence gating and instant feedback.
ideas.title: GhoulMetrics: Automated Biomechanical Pitch & Form Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced computer vision integration with real-time confidence scoring, a proven winner at engineering hackathons.
